And Ram [Hall] was on the drums with that band?

items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Well believe it or not, Joe Dantzburg and I started them out.

In the late years you know I had to follow a style too. That's what I said the other night when you hear, I'm doing a lot of things twenty years ago I don't think I had to do it.
